From 0b1eddc1964351cd5ce57aff46853ed4ce9ebbff Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Michal Kalderon <michal.kalderon@marvell.com>
Date: Wed, 2 Sep 2020 19:57:35 +0300
Subject: [PATCH] RDMA/qedr: Fix doorbell setting

Change the doorbell setting so that the maximum value between the last and
current value is set. This is to avoid doorbells being lost.

Fixes: a7efd7773e31 ("qedr: Add support for PD,PKEY and CQ verbs")
Link: https://lore.kernel.org/r/20200902165741.8355-3-michal.kalderon@marvell.com
Signed-off-by: Michal Kalderon <michal.kalderon@marvell.com>
Signed-off-by: Jason Gunthorpe <jgg@nvidia.com>

diff --git a/drivers/infiniband/hw/qedr/verbs.c b/drivers/infiniband/hw/qedr/verbs.c
index bf5fa8db7837..1da0131d5042 100644
--- a/drivers/infiniband/hw/qedr/verbs.c
+++ b/drivers/infiniband/hw/qedr/verbs.c
@@ -989,7 +989,7 @@ int qedr_create_cq(struct ib_cq *ibcq, const struct ib_cq_init_attr *attr,
 		/* Generate doorbell address. */
 		cq->db.data.icid = cq->icid;
 		cq->db_addr = dev->db_addr + db_offset;
-		cq->db.data.params = DB_AGG_CMD_SET <<
+		cq->db.data.params = DB_AGG_CMD_MAX <<
 		    RDMA_PWM_VAL32_DATA_AGG_CMD_SHIFT;
 
 		/* point to the very last element, passing it we will toggle */
-- 
2.25.1

### Modifications in Each File

1. **File: `drivers/infiniband/hw/qedr/verbs.c`**
   - The line that sets the `params` for the doorbell was modified. 
   - The original code used `DB_AGG_CMD_SET`, which has been changed to `DB_AGG_CMD_MAX`. This change alters the behavior of how the doorbell command is generated, ensuring that the maximum value between the last and current value is set.

### Relationships Between Modifications

- The modification in `verbs.c` directly addresses the issue of doorbell signals potentially being lost by changing the command used to set the doorbell. By using `DB_AGG_CMD_MAX`, the patch ensures that the doorbell setting reflects the maximum value, which is crucial for maintaining the integrity of doorbell operations in the RDMA/qedr driver. This change is a fix for the previously introduced functionality in commit `a7efd7773e31`, which added support for PD, PKEY, and CQ verbs, indicating that the new command is necessary to enhance the reliability of the features added in that commit.

        Root cause:
        The bug was caused by the use of `DB_AGG_CMD_SET` for setting the doorbell, which did not account for the possibility of doorbells being lost. This could lead to situations where the doorbell signal was not properly registered, especially when multiple signals were generated in quick succession. By not ensuring that the maximum value between the last and current doorbell values was set, the implementation risked missing important notifications in the RDMA operations.
